text:
ali: Quick flag — observed Node SDK emitting an incomplete final JSON when the connection is cut mid-event (no trailing newline). Browser shows same.
sam: Minimal repro?
ali: Start stream, send 'data: {"text": "hi' then kill connection. Node's line parser drops the fragment. Python flushes it.
mina: Likely cause: parser only emits on newline. We should attempt a final parse on 'close'/'end' events.
ops-bot: CI alert: nightly stream_parser_test flaky (see https://ci.internal/212).
sam: Two concerns: 1) avoid emitting half-JSON unless app opts-in; 2) avoid double-emitting when reconnect replay happens.
ali: Agreed. Proposal: on termination try parse remainder but mark emission as provisional; if reconnect delivers the completed event, prefer completed and drop provisional. Add small dedupe cache for exact matches.
mina: Also add unit test that splits JSON across two data events and then triggers close with 499 to mimic proxies.
sam: I'll draft a small patch to call parser.flushRemaining(true) on termination and add dedupe. Backport to 0.13.x after tests. ETA tomorrow.
ali: For immediate workaround, apps can call sdk.stream(...).flushOnAbort = true or call parser.flush() in abort handler. Document in SDK migration guide.
mina: I'll update parity matrix and examples/streaming-handling sample to show robust client handling.
ops-bot: Ticket created: DX-4211 "sse: handle final fragment + dedupe on reconnect" assigned to @sam.
sam: Thanks — will post PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
